capabilities: Freeze header rows and left columns in Reading view
Open a single table in full screen
Filter table rows with a search box
Highlight cells containing given text with up to three color rules
Set column widths automatically, fit to pane, or by text length
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.15.0 or later. Freezing applies only in the Reading view pane, not in embeds, hover previews or canvas cards. The plugin never modifies notes.
problem: Long and wide Markdown tables scroll their header rows and first columns out of view, which makes them hard to read.

relations.evidence: Install the BRAT plugin, choose Add beta plugin and enter daisen4/obsidian-table-focus.

summary: Display-only table reader that freezes header rows and left columns, opens one table in full screen, and can filter rows and highlight cells.
